methodologyNotes: The roster covers 12 GPS cycling computers spanning the mainstream market (2018–2024 release window): Garmin Edge 130 Plus, 540, 840, 1040, 1050; Wahoo Elemnt Bolt V2, Roam V2, Ace; Hammerhead Karoo 3; Bryton Rider S800; Sigma ROX 12.1 Evo; Lezyne Mega XL. Primary sources were manufacturer product pages (garmin.com, ride.lezyne.com, global.brytonsport.com, sigma.bike, shop.sram.com for Hammerhead) and official press releases; secondary corroboration used DC Rainmaker in-depth reviews, BikeRadar, Cycling News, and Cyclists Hub. Booleans are true when the feature is confirmed present and false when confirmed absent; null is used when the source consulted did not definitively state either way. Battery life in hours reflects standard GPS-on mode (not battery-saver), as stated by the manufacturer or confirmed by DC Rainmaker; multiband_gnss = true only for L1+L5 dual-frequency or confirmed multi-band hardware (not merely multi-constellation single-band). All prices are published US MSRP / current US store price in USD at the time of access. Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-19 against manufacturer pages and reputable reviews; all 12 products confirmed to exist with corroborated headline specs. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Garmin Edge 130 Plus
products.provenance: Display (1.8 in), weight (33 g), battery life (12 hr), and button-only control confirmed via Garmin product page and multiple reviews (re-verified 2026-06-19). GPS/GLONASS/Galileo multi-constellation but single-band — no L1+L5 multiband_gnss. No preloaded routable maps (basemap only; routing requires download). Price $199.99 confirmed at garmin.com and major US retailers (REI, Amazon).

products.name: Garmin Edge 540
products.provenance: Display 2.6 in (246×322 px), weight 80 g (80.4 g per Cycling Weekly), button-only (no touchscreen), multiband GNSS confirmed via Garmin product page and DC Rainmaker April 2023 review (re-verified 2026-06-19). Battery life 26 hr in standard GPS mode. Ships with one preloaded Garmin Cycle Map region (16 GB storage; 840/1040 carry two regions) — preloaded_maps=true confirmed. Source URL corrected to canonical product page (p/798938); MSRP $349.99.

products.name: Garmin Edge 840
products.provenance: Display 2.6 in with hybrid touchscreen + buttons, multiband GNSS, two preloaded map regions (32 GB storage) confirmed via Garmin product page and DC Rainmaker review (re-verified 2026-06-19). Non-solar weight 85 g (solar variant 89 g) per Garmin/reviews. Battery life 26 hr standard GPS mode (32 hr battery-saver per owner's manual). MSRP $449.99 confirmed via garmin.com and Amazon.

products.name: Garmin Edge 1040
products.priceNote: MSRP at launch; non-solar model now largely discontinued — clearance pricing varies
products.provenance: Display 3.5 in (282×470 px), weight 126 g (non-solar), touchscreen, multiband GNSS, preloaded North America + EMEA maps confirmed via Garmin and DC Rainmaker June 2022 review (re-verified 2026-06-19). Battery life 35 hr standard GPS mode (70 hr battery-saver). Launch MSRP $599.99; non-solar variant largely discontinued by 2026 but retained as a notable recent model. Release June 8 2022.

products.name: Garmin Edge 1050
products.provenance: Display 3.5 in at 480×800 px (up to 1,000 nit), weight 161 g, touchscreen, preloaded Garmin Cycle Maps with Trailforks data confirmed via Garmin product page and DC Rainmaker review (re-verified 2026-06-19). Battery 20 hr standard GPS mode (60 hr battery-saver) confirmed by DCR and Cyclingnews. Multiband GNSS and ANT+/Bluetooth confirmed. Release June 2024. Source URL corrected from newsroom press release to canonical product page (p/1196129); MSRP $699.99 confirmed at garmin.com.

products.name: Wahoo Elemnt Bolt V2
products.priceNote: MSRP; superseded by Bolt V3 (launched Jan 2026), V2 still sold through stock
products.provenance: Display 2.2 in (240×320 px, 64-color), weight 70 g head unit, battery 15 hr, button-only control confirmed via BikeRadar and Wahoo support page (re-verified 2026-06-19). Onboard routable maps preloaded (Europe, North America, Australia; rest via Wi-Fi) — preloaded_maps=true confirmed. Single-band multi-constellation GPS — not multiband L1+L5. MSRP $279.99 per US retailers. priceNote corrected: successor Bolt V3 launched January 2026 (not May 2025).

products.name: Wahoo Elemnt Roam V2
products.priceNote: MSRP, device only; frequently discounted to ~$369 at retail in 2026
products.provenance: Display 2.7 in (400×240 px, 64-color), dual-band GPS confirmed by Wahoo and reviews (multiband_gnss=true). Preloaded global maps confirmed. Weight ~99 g. Battery 17 hr per Wahoo. Button-only control. Release 2022. MSRP $399.99 (commonly discounted to ~$369 at Walmart/retail in 2026); re-verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Wahoo Elemnt Ace
products.provenance: Display 3.8 in touchscreen, weight 208 g, dual-frequency GPS (multiband confirmed by DCR testing), preloaded global maps, ANT+/Bluetooth confirmed via DC Rainmaker December 2024 in-depth review (re-verified 2026-06-19). Claimed battery life 30 hr (DCR found real-world closer to 10–17 hr; 30 hr is Wahoo's stated figure). MSRP $599.99 per Wahoo and DCR. Release December 2024. Integrated wind/aero sensor is a unique feature not captured in standard spec keys.

products.name: Hammerhead Karoo 3
products.priceNote: Current US price per shop.sram.com (Hammerhead store), June 2026; launch MSRP was $474.99
products.provenance: Display 3.2 in Gorilla Glass touchscreen, weight 118 g (~117 g per reviews), multi-band L1+L5 GNSS, free global preloaded maps, ANT+/Bluetooth confirmed via DC Rainmaker May 2024 review and SRAM/Hammerhead product page (re-verified 2026-06-19). Battery 15 hr standard GPS. PRICE NOTE: launch MSRP was $474.99 (May 2024); current price on shop.sram.com (official Hammerhead storefront) is $524.99 as of June 2026 — priceUsd reflects the current published store price, confirmed directly by fetching the SRAM store page. Release May 2024.

products.name: Bryton Rider S800
products.priceNote: MSRP, device only (E model); sensor bundle $479.95
products.provenance: Display 3.4 in color MIP touchscreen, weight 106 g, battery 36 hr claimed, preloaded OSM maps, ANT+/BLE/Wi-Fi confirmed via Bryton product page and Amazon listing (re-verified 2026-06-19). Multi-constellation (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS) but single-band — Cyclists Hub and BikeRadar explicitly note absence of dual-band/multiband GNSS as a limitation; multiband_gnss=false. MSRP $399.95 (E model), $479.95 sensor bundle, per Amazon US. Release 2022.

products.name: Sigma ROX 12.1 Evo
products.provenance: Display 3.0 in (76 mm) touchscreen (240×400 px, 16M colors), weight 112 g (per BikeRadar; draft's 110 g corrected to 112 g), battery 14 hr standard, preloaded multi-country maps confirmed via sigma.bike and BikeRadar (re-verified 2026-06-19). Multi-constellation GPS/GLONASS/Galileo/BeiDou but single-band — no L1+L5 dual-band, noted as a limitation by reviews; multiband_gnss=false. MSRP $379.95. Released June 12 2023.

products.name: Lezyne Mega XL
products.provenance: Display 2.7 in (240×400 px), weight 83 g, 48 hr claimed battery, four-button control (no touchscreen), preloaded offline maps, ANT+/Bluetooth confirmed via ride.lezyne.com and Cyclingnews review (re-verified 2026-06-19). Price $199.99 confirmed on Lezyne page and retailers. GPS+GLONASS dual-constellation single-band — not multiband L1+L5. Oldest model in the set; retained as a notable long-battery-life value option still actively sold. Release 2018.
